depth.lede: Every concern lives at a different depth. Scroll down through the skin and see what we use at each layer.
depth.diagramLabel: Diagram: a cross-section of skin showing the surface, dermis, fat and muscle layers

stops.p: Dullness, congestion, breakouts. Facials and peels work on the outermost layer, with nothing to recover from.
Texture, scars, sun spots, fine lines and hair follicles all live here. Microneedling, PRP, light and laser reach it.
With time, the soft padding under the skin thins. Fillers restore shape where things have gone flat.
Expression lines come from movement. Neurotoxins relax the muscle so the skin above it can smooth out.
Some things start below the skin. Medically supervised weight management and IV hydration look after the rest.

steps.p: Call, or leave your number. We'll find a time that suits you.
We look at your skin, ask about your health and goals, and give you a plan with prices.
Begin your treatment, or take the plan home and think about it. No pressure either way.
We check in after your treatment and adjust the plan as your skin changes.

items.a: Yes. Your consult is free and there's no obligation to book a treatment afterwards.
$13 per unit. We count your units with you before we start, so the total is clear up front.
Sara Aryal, our owner, is a medical aesthetician, certified injector and laser technician with 15 years in the industry. Anju, NP, leads our medical services, including weight management.
Yes. We accept CareCredit, which lets you spread the cost of treatments over time, subject to approval.
Veterans, first responders, teachers and students get an extra 5% off all services. Members also get 10% off fillers and other services.
Memberships run for 12 months at one monthly price. Each club bundles treatments you would use anyway, and members get 10% off fillers and other services.
Most facials, Botox and laser hair removal have none. Microneedling, IPL and Tribella can leave you pink or speckled for a day or two. We'll tell you exactly what to expect before you book.

items.q: Is medical weight loss right for me?
items.a: It starts with a health review with Anju, NP. If a medically supervised plan isn't right for you, we'll tell you.
11751 Alta Vista Rd, Suite 303, Fort Worth, TX 76244, in North Fort Worth near Keller. Open Monday to Friday 10am to 6pm and Saturday 10am to 2pm.
